title: A zero crop target left available seed variety unused
claim: The fortress had seed stocks for additional underground crops while autofarm's default target for those crops was zero. A quarry-bush target and a conditional process-to-bag order were added; a two-job processing order subsequently completed.
reproduction: Inspect installed autofarm status, real seed access, available farm area and seasonal compatibility. Configure an appropriate crop target and its processing/storage chain, then verify harvest and processing independently. Keep brewing crops and seed reserves protected.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
Five quarry-bush seeds and five empty indoor bags were observed before configuring the chain.
The quarry-bush target became 40; the native report later recorded completion of Process plant to bag (2).
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. Leaf and seed yields were not quantified. The large prepared-meal recovery followed imported fruit and must not be attributed solely to quarry bushes. Crop targets and processing conditions require local resource review.
